Layout

Layout provides two components maui-row and maui-col for row and column layout (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

The Layout component provides a 24-column grid, and the width percentage of the columns is set by adding the span attribute on Col. In addition, adding the offset attribute can set the offset width of the column, calculated in the same way as span.

<maui-row>
  <maui-col span="8">span: 8</maui-col>
  <maui-col span="8">span: 8</maui-col>
  <maui-col span="8">span: 8</maui-col>
</maui-row>

<maui-row>
  <maui-col span="4">span: 4</maui-col>
  <maui-col span="10" offset="4">offset: 4, span: 10</maui-col>
</maui-row>

<maui-row>
  <maui-col offset="12" span="12">offset: 12, span: 12</maui-col>
</maui-row>

2. Set column element spacing

The spacing between column elements can be set through the gutter attribute. The default spacing is 0.

<maui-row gutter="20">
  <maui-col span="8">span: 8</maui-col>
  <maui-col span="8">span: 8</maui-col>
  <maui-col span="8">span: 8</maui-col>
</maui-row>

API

Row Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
gutter Spacing between column elements in px String | Number -

Col Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
span Column element width String | Number -
offset Column element offset distance String | Number -
